rules.title: Ban on algorithmic devices used to set rents or occupancy levels
rules.requirement: Landlords in San Francisco may not sell or use algorithmic devices (software that analyzes nonpublic competitor rental data) to recommend what rent to charge for a vacant unit or to manage occupancy levels. Tenants or the City Attorney may sue to enforce the ban.
rules.penalty: Civil action may be brought by a tenant or the City Attorney against a violating entity.
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
